title: 'Go with the Clouds, North by Northwest' Anime's 1st Promo Video Reveals 2027 Premiere on Netflix
content: The official website for the television anime of Aki Irie 's Go with the Clouds, North by Northwest ( Hokuhokusei ni Kumo to Yuke ) manga began streaming on Friday the first promotional video, and it reveals that Tomohiro Ōno will star as Kei Miyama.
author: ANN

title: 'Hokuhokusei ni Kumo to Ike' Reveals Lead Cast, Staff, First Promo, 2027 Debut
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Aki Irie 's Hokuhokusei ni Kumo to Ike ( Go with the Clouds, North-by-Northwest ) manga revealed the lead cast, main staff, a key visual (pictured), and the first promotional video on Thursday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Magic Knight Rayearth' Reveals Additional Cast
content: The official website for the new Magic Knight Rayearth ( Mahou Kishi Rayearth ) television anime announced additional cast members on Thursday. The anime series premiered on October 7 at 11.45 p.m. on TV Asahi's "IMAnimation W" frame.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Crunchyroll Acquires The Apothecary Diaries Anime Film
content: The film will open in theaters in Japan on December 11 and feature a brand-new story by the original novel series' author Hyuganatsu . Mariya Ise joins the cast as Mu Qing (English romanization not confirmed).
author: ANN

title: Manga 'Kimi wa Yotsuba no Clover' Ends in Next Chapter
content: The official X account for author Koushi announced on Thursday that the Kimi wa Yotsuba no Clover ( You Are a Four Leaf Clover ) manga will end with its next chapter. The 106th and final chapter is scheduled to be released on Weekly Shounen Champion issue 2026 No.46 on October 15.
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady's Treasure Anime Film Acquired by Crunchyroll for Global Theatrical Release
content: Crunchyroll has acquired the North American and worldwide distribution rights for The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure anime film. Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment will distribute the film, with theatrical release dates to be announced.
author: Anime Corner

title: New The Apothecary Diaries Movie Confirms U.S. Release With Big Screen Plans
content: The Apothecary Diaries is back in action this Fall with the third season of the TV anime series , and it has been confirmed that the new feature film debut for the franchise is coming to the big screen across North America too.
author: ComicBook

title: Additional Cast for 'Marronnier Oukoku no Shichinin no Kishi' Announced
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Nao Iwamoto 's Marronnier Oukoku no Shichinin no Kishi ( The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom ) manga announced the additional cast on Thursday. The anime premiered on October 3 at 6.25 p.m. on NHK E-Tele.
author: MyAnimeList
